purpose: Minimal static LoRA comparison prerequisite: family-safe Train episodes, Silver/Gold governance, LlamaFactory export, tokenization check, train-split dataset, and DryRun contract validation (training_verified=false).

base_model.source: modelscope local download (user-provided; not transferred by Git)

gold.governance: pure-python AgentSFTGovernancePipeline (identical M2 operators; DataFlow execution layer not re-run on this device, its pinned package was not transferred)

tokenization_check.note: transformers-native check on the same tokenizer files; the pinned LlamaFactory 0.9.4 loader was not re-run on this device

claim_boundary: Data and contract stage only; no real training or checkpoint exists yet.
training_verified=false is mandatory until a real PEFT run produces a validated checkpoint and artifacts.
The real LoRA run requires a GPU (RTX 5080 on the Windows host; the agent sandbox has no GPU access) and must pin this base-model revision with the frozen training config.
Six deterministic train episodes are a minimal contract batch, not a statistically meaningful SFT dataset.
